---
title: "Mundane"
---

Mundane astrology reads national events through a country's own chart. This
track asks, openly, whether recorded events of a given kind (earthquakes,
floods, the start of a war, a change of government) fall more often around the
configurations that mundane astrologers name when those are read against the
country's founding chart. The method, the data and the rules are public, so
anyone can rerun the comparison, correct an input or add a rule.

## Where it stands

The study is seeded and no hypothesis has been tested. The data and the
feature pipeline are in place; the pre-registration is a draft that waits for
founding times with citations. Results will be posted here as found, whether
they are positive, null or mixed.

## The data and its limits

- **113 countries**, each with a founding date and a rationale. Every founding
  time in the source was a placeholder (midnight or noon), so all times are
  recorded as unknown. Without a time there is no lagna and no houses; only
  sign-level features can be tested: transiting planets against the signs of
  natal planets, eclipses, Sun ingresses and planetary stations.
- **825 events** with title, date, type and a link to Wikipedia. The types come
  from an unreviewed crawl and some are wrong (an 1868 earthquake is typed
  War, epidemics are typed Political), so every row is marked as not yet
  reviewed.
- **Catalogues** for earthquakes (USGS) and floods (Dartmouth Flood
  Observatory) are fetched as hashed snapshots; EM-DAT is fetch-on-demand
  because its licence forbids redistribution.

The files and fields are described in the study's
[data notes](https://github.com/astro-fusion/astro_research-white-paper/blob/main/studies/mundane/data/README.md).

## What an astrologer can contribute

1. **A sourced founding time** for a country, with a citation. Competing
   charts are welcome; each is listed and tested separately.
2. **A corrected event type**, by editing one row of the events file.
3. **A new rule**, without writing code, through the
   [astrologers' contribution guide](https://github.com/astro-fusion/astro_research-white-paper/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING_ASTROLOGERS.md).

## Countries and their founding-time status

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path
import yaml

path = Path("..") / "studies" / "mundane" / "data" / "countries.yaml"
rows = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["countries"]
known = sum(1 for c in rows if c["founding"]["time_known"])
print(f"{len(rows)} countries; {known} with a sourced founding time.\n")
print("| Country | ISO | Founding date | Time known | Competing charts |")
print("|---|---|---|---|---|")
for c in sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["name"]):
    f = c["founding"]
    print(
        f"| {c['name']} | {c['iso']} | {f['date']} | "
        f"{'yes' if f['time_known'] else 'no'} | {len(c['candidate_charts'])} |"
    )
```

Data: AstroFusion mundane dataset, CC BY 4.0 (dates, coordinates and titles).
